    O=[row[:] for row in I]; h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r][c]==1]
    s=sorted(seeds); (r1,c1),(r2,c2),(r3,c3)=s
    step=(r2-r1, c2-c1)
    k=0
    while True:
        rr0=r1-k*step[0]; cc0=c1-k*step[1]
        rr1=r3+k*step[0]; cc1=c3+k*step[1]
        top=[rr0,rr1]; bot=[rr1,rr0]
        rows0,rows1=sorted(top)
        cols0,cols1=sorted(cc0,cc1)
        for r in range(max(0,rows0), min(h,rows1+1)):
            pass
        # paint rectangle ring clipped
        for c in range(max(0,cols0), min(w,cols1+1)):
            for rr in (rows0,rows1):
                if 0<=rr<h: O[rr][c]=1
        for r in range(max(0,rows0), min(h,rows1+1)):
            for cc in (cols0,cols1):
                if 0<=cc<w: O[r][cc]=1
        k+=1
        if k>100 or rows1<-1 or cc1<-1 or rows0>w or cc0>w: break
    return O
I=allG['Demo pair 7 input']; O=allG['Demo pair 7 output']
print(fP7(I)==O)
